raw_fields.name: sbp
raw_fields.label: Systolic blood pressure
raw_fields.help: The top number of a blood pressure reading.

raw_fields.name: tobacco
raw_fields.label: Cumulative tobacco use
raw_fields.help: Total tobacco used over a lifetime, not per year.

raw_fields.name: ldl
raw_fields.label: LDL cholesterol
raw_fields.help: LDL ('bad') cholesterol. The dataset does not state the unit; values look like mmol/L.

raw_fields.name: adiposity
raw_fields.label: Adiposity
raw_fields.help: A body-fat measure similar to BMI. Not precisely defined in the source dataset.

raw_fields.name: famhist
raw_fields.label: Family history of heart disease
raw_fields.help: Whether a close relative had ischaemic heart disease.

raw_fields.name: typea
raw_fields.label: Type A behavior score
raw_fields.help: Score from the Bortner questionnaire (scale 12-84). 55 or more counted as Type A in the original study.

raw_fields.name: obesity
raw_fields.label: Body mass index (BMI)
raw_fields.help: Weight in kg divided by height in metres squared.

raw_fields.name: alcohol
raw_fields.label: Current alcohol consumption
raw_fields.help: The dataset does not state the unit.

population_note: Trained on 462 men aged 15-64 from a high-risk region of South Africa (case-control sample). Not validated for women or for people outside this age range.
